description: Ministry of Agriculture - 3rd  Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Agriculture Service
reasoning: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Agriculture Service, specifically detailing service conditions, promotion qualifications, and performance appraisal requirements for public service officers. It focuses on public sector service administration, including years of service requirements, salary increments, and performance evaluation procedures - all characteristic of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
